# SLA Capital

> SLA Capital (Sir Lends A Lot LLC) is an AI-enhanced private lender for real
> estate investors, lending in 42 US states. Business-purpose loans only — no
> owner-occupied lending. Three core programs: DSCR rental loans, Fix & Flip
> bridge loans, and New Construction loans. Transparent pricing: rates are
> published publicly and the rate quoted is the rate at closing, with no
> application fees and no hidden junk fees. NMLS ID #2863552 · Idaho Mortgage Broker/Lender License #MBL-2082863552 · Certified Member, American
> Association of Private Lenders (AAPL) · 707 W Main Ave #31, Spokane, WA 99201.

Site: https://slacapital.ai
Apply: https://slacapital.ai/apply/
Contact: apply@slacapital.com · (509) 846-7349

## Loan Programs

- [DSCR Rental Loans](https://slacapital.ai/rental/): 30-year fixed rates from
  6.65% (before buy down: highest credit tier, DSCR 1.20+); also 5/6, 7/6, 10/6 ARM and
  5-year interest-only. Loans $100K–$3M. Up to 80% LTV purchase / 75% cash-out.
  Minimum 1.0 DSCR (below-1.0 lane available with reserves or rate adjustment).
  Minimum 660 FICO. No tax returns, no W-2s, no DTI. Close in an LLC. Cash-out
  refinance seasoning is 6 months — the industry standard, and no active lease is required at
  closing (market-rent appraisal qualifies — this is also how short-term
  rentals/Airbnbs are underwritten). Portfolio loans blanket 2–10 properties
  on one note.
- [Fix & Flip Loans](https://slacapital.ai/fix-n-flip/): purchase + rehab
  bridge financing sized off ARV. Rates from 9.5%. Up to 92.5% loan-to-cost
  for experienced borrowers with 100% of the rehab budget funded via draws;
  first-timers welcome (~85% LTC to start). Funding in as little as 72 hours;
  average close 7–10 days. Loans $100K–$3M. 6–18 month terms.
- [New Construction Loans](https://slacapital.ai/new-construction/): land +
  vertical build at up to 85% of land cost and 85% of construction cost. Rates
  from 10%. 18 or 24 month terms with straightforward extensions. Draws via
  online portal with app-based inspections; interest on drawn balance. Loans
  $100K–$7.5M. Spec builds and build-to-rent welcome.

## Rates

- [Current Rates](https://slacapital.ai/rates/): live published rates for all
  three programs — no call required, honored at closing.

  ARV, LTC, seasoning, draws, BRRRR, and 24 terms in plain English.

## Guides

- [DSCR Loans Explained](https://slacapital.ai/blog/dscr-loans-explained/):
  how DSCR qualification actually works — the ratio, PITIA, below-1.0 lanes.
- [DSCR Loan Requirements](https://slacapital.ai/blog/dscr-loan-requirements/):
  credit tiers, down payment/LTV, reserves, property types, LLC closing.
- [DSCR Calculator](https://slacapital.ai/blog/dscr-calculator/): the formula,
  a live calculator, worked examples, and five levers when the ratio is short.
- [How to Choose a DSCR Lender](https://slacapital.ai/blog/how-to-choose-a-dscr-lender/):
  12 questions that separate honest lenders from bait-and-switch shops.
- [DSCR vs. Conventional Mortgage](https://slacapital.ai/blog/dscr-vs-conventional-mortgage/):
  an honest comparison, including when conventional still wins.
- [DSCR Cash-Out Seasoning](https://slacapital.ai/blog/dscr-cash-out-seasoning/):
  3 vs 6 vs 12 month windows and the BRRRR math.
- [DSCR Loans for Airbnb & STRs](https://slacapital.ai/blog/dscr-loans-for-airbnb/):
  how short-term rentals are qualified on long-term market rent.
- [BRRRR Method Financing](https://slacapital.ai/blog/brrrr-method-financing/):
  the two-loan playbook with a full worked example.
- [ARV in Fix & Flip Lending](https://slacapital.ai/blog/arv-fix-and-flip-explained/):
  how after-repair value is underwritten.
- [Fix & Flip Loans for Beginners](https://slacapital.ai/blog/fix-and-flip-loans-for-beginners/):
  first-deal financing, realistic leverage, and the mistakes that sink flips.
- [Hard Money vs. DSCR](https://slacapital.ai/blog/hard-money-vs-dscr-loans/):
  which loan fits which deal, and the bridge-to-DSCR play.
- [Buying Rentals in an LLC](https://slacapital.ai/blog/llc-rental-property-loans/):
  entity vesting, the personal guaranty, and the five documents that matter.
- [How Construction Draws Work](https://slacapital.ai/blog/how-construction-draws-work/):
  the request → inspection → funding cycle.
- [Spec Home Construction Loans](https://slacapital.ai/blog/spec-home-construction-loans/):
  ground-up financing, the two leverage tests, and planning the exit.
